title: SonicCraft timeline
description: A SonicCraft timeline (DSL v1.0): a declarative multi-track audio composition of text-to-speech cues, music beds and sound effects that SonicCraft compiles into a sidechain-ducked, loudness-mastered audio file with optional WebVTT/SRT subtitles. Keys are snake_case; unknown keys are errors unless they start with `x-` or `x_` (annotations); `null` means the key is absent. Times accept milliseconds (350) or strings with lowercase units such as "350ms", "1.5s" or "00:01:30.500".

output.description: Output file, format and mastering settings.

subtitles.description: Caption layout settings. Subtitle export itself is enabled with `output.export_subtitles`.

defaults.description: Voice settings applied to every speech cue (lowest priority after provider defaults).

speakers.description: Named speakers. A cue or speech track with `speaker: <name>` inherits that speaker's voice.

providers.description:
Named TTS provider instances. Cues reference them by name via `provider`.
Built-in provider names (elevenlabs, openai, cartesia, kokoro/local_kokoro, piper, macos_say, command, mock)
work without any entry here.

tracks.description: The tracks of the composition. Required and non-empty.

format.description:
Container/codec: wav, mp3, flac, ogg, opus or m4a. Default: from the output path extension, else wav.
ogg, opus and m4a require ffmpeg on PATH.

path.description: Output path relative to the timeline file. Default: `<timeline stem>.<ext>` next to the timeline.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. Default 48000.

bitrate.description: Bitrate for lossy formats, e.g. "320k", "192k" or 192000. Default mp3 192k, ogg 160k, opus 96k, m4a 160k.

bit_depth.description: Bit depth for wav (16, 24, or 32 = float) and flac (16 or 24). Default 24.

loudness_preset.description:
Loudness preset: podcast (-16 LUFS, -1 dBTP), streaming (-14, -1), broadcast (EBU R128: -23, -1),
atsc (A/85: -24, -2). Default podcast.

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness target of the master in LUFS (overrides the preset). Range -60..-5.

true_peak_db.description: Maximum true peak of the master in dBTP (overrides the preset). Range -9..0.

normalize.description: Apply master loudness normalization. Default true. When false, the true-peak limiter still runs as a clip guard.

export_subtitles.description:
Export subtitles: true (= vtt + srt), false, or a list of formats from vtt, srt, json (captions + word
timestamps) and transcript (HyperFrames-compatible word array).

export_stems.description: Export one 32-bit float WAV stem per track to `<output stem>.stems/`. Default false.

export_manifest.description: Write the render report to `<output stem>.manifest.json`. Default false.

tail_ms.description:
Time after the last finite item (speech, non-looping clips) before the end. Default: the longest
`fade_out_ms` among looping/open-ended beds, else 0.

duration_ms.description: Force the total duration. Content beyond it is cut.

dither.description: TPDF dither when writing 16-bit PCM. Default true.

OutputSpec.description: Output file, format and mastering settings.

Bitrate.description: Bitrate for lossy formats: a string like "320k" or "192kbps", or a number (bits per second; values below 1000 are kbps). At most 10 Mbit/s.

SubtitleExport.description: Subtitle export switch: `true` (= vtt + srt), `false`, a single format, or a list of formats (vtt, srt, json).

Millis.description: Signed time value (negative values move the anchor earlier): a number of milliseconds (at most 86400000 = 24 h), or a string with lowercase units such as "350ms", "1.5s", "2m", "1m30s", "01:30.5" or "00:01:30.500".

max_chars_per_line.description: Maximum characters per caption line. Default 42.

max_duration_ms.description: Maximum on-screen duration of one caption. Default 6000 ms.

min_duration_ms.description: Minimum on-screen duration of one caption (extended when possible). Default 800 ms.

speaker_labels.description: Prefix captions with speaker labels. Default: on when there are 2+ distinct speakers.

speech_overlap.description: What to do when speech cues overlap: push (default; moves implicitly-placed cues later), warn, error, allow.

min_gap_ms.description: Gap inserted when `push` moves a cue that has no explicit preceding pause. Default 250 ms.

overlap_tolerance_ms.description: Overlaps shorter than this are ignored. Default 20 ms.

reference_lufs.description: Source-level normalization target in LUFS for tracks with `normalize` enabled. Default -20.

provider.description: Provider instance name (a key of `providers`, or a built-in provider name).

voice_id.description: Provider-specific voice identifier (e.g. an ElevenLabs voice id, an OpenAI voice name, a Kokoro voice like am_adam).

model.description: Provider model id (e.g. eleven_multilingual_v2, gpt-4o-mini-tts, sonic-2).

language.description: Language code passed to providers that support it (e.g. "en").

settings.description: Provider-specific voice settings (e.g. ElevenLabs stability/similarity_boost, OpenAI instructions, speed).

gain_db.description: Extra gain in dB for this speaker's cues.

label.description: Display name used in subtitles. Default: the speaker key.

VoiceSpec.description: Voice settings. Used for `defaults`, entries of `speakers`, and inline on speech tracks and cues.

type.description:
Built-in provider type: elevenlabs, openai, cartesia, kokoro, piper, macos_say, command or mock.
Defaults to the instance name when that is a built-in name or alias.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the API key (never put keys in the timeline).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel requests to this instance.

chars_per_second.description:
Speaking rate (characters per second, spaces and punctuation included) assumed for dry-run duration
estimates. Preferred over `words_per_minute`.

words_per_minute.description: Speaking rate (words per minute) assumed for dry-run estimates when `chars_per_second` is not set.

settings.description: Default voice settings for cues using this instance.

stdin.description: Template written to the child's stdin for `command`/`piper` providers, e.g. "{text}".

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with cue and clip ids).

type.description: Track type: speech, music or sfx.

gain_db.description: Extra fader gain in dB. Default 0.

mute.description: Exclude the track from the mix (it is still laid out). Default false.

normalize.description: Source-level loudness normalization: true/false or {target_lufs}. Default: speech and music true, sfx false.

start_at_ms.description: Absolute start of the track's first item (when that item has no explicit start).

start_relative.description: Relative start of the track's first item.

ducking.description: Duck this track while other tracks are active.

speaker.description: (speech) Speaker name for all cues of this track.

provider.description: (speech) Provider instance for all cues of this track.

voice_id.description: (speech) Voice id for all cues of this track.

model.description: (speech) Model for all cues of this track.

language.description: (speech) Language for all cues of this track.

settings.description: (speech) Provider-specific voice settings for all cues of this track.

trim_silence.description: (speech) Trim leading/trailing silence from synthesized cues: true/false or {threshold_db, padding_ms}. Default true.

source.description: (music/sfx) Audio file path, relative to the timeline file.

loop.description: (music/sfx) Loop the source to fill the clip length (open-ended loops run until the timeline end).

loop_crossfade_ms.description: (music/sfx) Equal-power crossfade at loop seams. Default 0.

trim_start_ms.description: (music/sfx) Offset into the source where playback begins. Default 0.

clips.description: (music/sfx) Multiple clips placed on this track (alternative to the single-clip shorthand).

Track.description:
A track. `type` selects which fields apply: speech tracks use `sequence` and voice fields; music and sfx
tracks use either clip fields directly (single-clip shorthand) or a `clips` list.

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness target in LUFS for each source on this track.

after_cue.description: Anchor at the END of this item: start = end(ref) + offset.

with_cue.description: Anchor at the START of this item: start = start(ref) + offset.

before_cue.description: (start_relative only) This item ENDS at start(ref) + offset.

offset_ms.description: Signed offset added to the anchor time. Default 0.

Anchor.description:
A relative time anchor. Exactly one of `after_cue`, `with_cue`, `before_cue`.
The referenced id may be a cue, a clip or a track.

trigger_tracks.description: Track ids whose activity ducks this track. Required.

reduction_db.description: Attenuation depth in dB (sign ignored: -18 and 18 both attenuate by 18 dB). Default -15.

attack_ms.description: Ramp time from 0 dB to full depth. Default 80 ms.

release_ms.description: Ramp time from full depth back to 0 dB. Default 400 ms.

hold_ms.description: Gaps shorter than this keep the duck engaged; activity is held this long. Default 250 ms.

lookahead_ms.description: Detect activity this much earlier so the bed is fully ducked when speech begins. Default = attack_ms.

threshold_db.description: RMS threshold in dBFS for sidechain mode. Default -40.

DuckingSpec.description: Sidechain ducking of a track while trigger tracks are active.

pause_duration.description: Pause length (pause items only), e.g. 350 or "350ms".

text.description: Text to speak. Required for cues.

subtitles.description: Include this cue in subtitle files. Default true.

settings.description: Provider-specific voice settings (merged over speaker/track/defaults settings).

start_at_ms.description: Absolute start time. Without a start the cue follows the previous item of its track.

start_relative.description: Start relative to another cue, clip or track.

allow_overlap.description: Allow this cue to overlap other speech (intentional crosstalk). Default false.

SequenceItem.description: An item of a speech track's `sequence`: either a pause (`pause_duration` or `pause`) or a cue (`text` + optional fields).

oneOf.title: Pause
oneOf.description: A pause: exactly one of `pause_duration` or `pause`, and nothing else.

oneOf.title: Cue
oneOf.description: A speech cue: requires `text`; pause keys are not allowed; at most one of `start_at_ms` / `start_relative`.

anyOf.description: Enable with defaults (-50 dBFS, 30 ms padding) or disable.

TrimSilenceInput.description: Silence trimming for synthesized speech: `true`, `false`, or `{threshold_db, padding_ms}`.

threshold_db.description: Level below which audio counts as silence, in dBFS. Default -50.

padding_ms.description: Silence kept before the first and after the last audible frame. Default 30 ms.

source.description: Audio file path, relative to the timeline file. Required.

start_at_ms.description: Absolute start time. Without a start the clip follows the previous clip (minus `crossfade_ms`).

start_relative.description: Start relative to a cue, clip or track.

trim_start_ms.description: Offset into the source where playback begins. Default 0.

loop.description: Loop the source to fill the clip length.

loop_crossfade_ms.description: Equal-power crossfade at loop seams. Default 0.

crossfade_ms.description:
Overlap with the previous clip of this track, with equal-power fades on both sides. Default 0. Only a
clip without its own start (no `start_at_ms`/`start_relative`) crossfades; elsewhere it is ignored.

Clip.description: A clip on a music or sfx track.

NonNegativeMillis.description: Time value (0 or more): a number of milliseconds (at most 86400000 = 24 h), or a string with lowercase units such as "350ms", "1.5s", "2m", "1m30s", "01:30.5" or "00:01:30.500".

PositiveMillis.description: Length (greater than 0): a number of milliseconds (at most 86400000 = 24 h), or a string with lowercase units such as "350ms", "1.5s", "2m", "1m30s", "01:30.5" or "00:01:30.500".

after_cue.description: Anchor at the END of this item: start = end(ref) + offset.

with_cue.description: Anchor at the START of this item: start = start(ref) + offset.

before_cue.description: Not valid in `end_relative` (`before_cue` is only valid in `start_relative`).

offset_ms.description: Signed offset added to the anchor time. Default 0.

EndAnchor.description: A relative end time. Exactly one of `after_cue` (end = end(ref) + offset) or `with_cue` (end = start(ref) + offset); `before_cue` is only valid in `start_relative`.

HttpProviderSettings.description: Checks of the HTTP providers (elevenlabs, openai, cartesia, kokoro).

CommandProviderSettings.description: Checks of `command` providers: an argv template that starts with the program.

PiperProviderSettings.description: Checks of `piper` providers: a custom argv template starts with the program.
